Strategy
In a normal situation, the Fund will invest 40% of its assets in interest-bearing investments and 60% in stock-based investments. The share of stock-based investments may vary between 20% and 80%. The aim of the investment activity of the fund is to increase the real value of invested capital in the long term, by spreading assets as stipulated in the Act on Mutual Funds and the fund rules. The aim of the fund is to generate returns for shareholders that, in the long term, exceed the return on the fund’s comparative index. Investment decisions are based on our portfolio manager’s views of the markets and stocks. The investment objectives are pursued through active asset management. The Fund may use derivative contracts as part of its standard investments activities to pursue its objectives. The Fund does not follow any comparative indexes in its activities, therefore investments may often differ considerably from the comparative index.
